posts.name: Silverleaf
posts.cooked:
I think it's just a difference between loser = "person who lost" and loser = "worthless failure person". They seem to be going for the first definition, but with a subtle hint at the second, suggesting that your play might lead to you representing a group of crappy superheroes if you don't win the game. 

Seems fine to me. It isn't insulting players (or the hero characters, or the game) as far as I can see. Insulting people isn't a good way to get people to buy games.
